title: App shell: cms.siteOrigin for sites served behind their own edge
description: Add optional cms.siteOrigin (https origin, rejected with cms.domainName) so PAPYRUS_SITE_ORIGIN and the OAuth redirect list use the edge host without an Amplify domain association. Tests in scripts/test-infra-site-config.ts and scripts/test-infra-synth.mjs; docs in README and site-hosting.md.
